prompts.gunner: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production transparent 2D top-down WWII strategy-game infantry sprite. Input image 1 and image 2 are STYLE AND UNIFORM references only, not edit targets. Create ONE German heavy machine gunner operating a deployed tripod-mounted belt-fed MG42-inspired heavy machine gun. STRICT DIRECTLY OVERHEAD 90-degree orthographic camera, exact camera of reference sprites; forward is DOWN toward bottom of canvas. Same chunky simplified low resolution hand-painted pixel-sprite look, thick nearly black outline, few large flat shadow blocks, DARK muted blue-grey uniform, grey-green steel helmet, brown webbing, tiny tan hands. A large round helmet hides face and most torso; compact crouched or low seated operator at upper rear of gun, arms reaching down to rear grips. Long straight narrow gun barrel points vertically DOWN; recognizable compact dark-steel receiver and a sturdy three-leg low tripod with spread feet on ground, NOT a bipod, NO wheels, NO shield. Tripod forward leg toward bottom and two rear side legs spreading up-left/up-right; do not resemble cannon. Short brass ochre ammunition belt feeds from gun's left. Gun silhouette readable when whole sprite is 32-38 pixels tall and helmet is 8 pixels across. Keep gunner human proportions identical to references; weapon/tripod only about one shoulder-width wider than man, compact total length about 1.6 rifleman's body length. Minimal texture, no microdetail or stippling, no glossy render, no rim lights. Center whole subject with 8 percent transparent padding, entire tripod and barrel visible. One man and mounted gun only; no other soldiers, no spare boxes, no firing effects, no ground, no cast ground shadow, no text, no panel, no checkerboard matte. GENUINE transparent alpha background.
prompts.loader: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: single transparent top-down German heavy-machine-gun crew infantry sprite. Image 1 is original game infantry STYLE/PROPORTIONS/UNIFORM reference; image 2 is new machine-gunner reference for matching colors, pixel scale and simplification. Create ONE ammunition-feeding assistant gunner, without a gun. STRICT 90-degree directly overhead orthographic view matching image 1 exactly. Soldier forward is DOWN toward bottom, large grey-green steel helmet hides face and chest, broad rounded shoulders, compact crouched/kneeling pose with two short bent legs. Dark muted blue-grey uniform, brown leather webbing, dark boots, muted olive pack, tiny tan hands. Same chunky coarse pixel-sprite look and heavy near-black contour as references, large simple shading blocks with minimal texture. Distinctive pose: both hands extend toward image RIGHT at lower chest level, holding one short curved brass-ochre ammo belt as if feeding a machine gun located just off-canvas to his right. A small closed dark olive rectangular ammo tin beside his LEFT hip as part of his gear. Hands and belt clear of helmet outline, belt only about one helmet width long. Whole sprite compact and no wider than 1.4 times original infantry. Keep reference helmet-to-shoulder proportions, readable as a 23-pixel-high figure. No visible face, no standing side view, no gun, no tripod, no other people, no ground, no cast shadow, no firing effects, no text, no frames, no checkerboard matte. Center subject with 8 percent clear transparent margins. Genuine transparent alpha background.
prompts.bearer: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: single transparent top-down German heavy-machine-gun ammunition bearer infantry sprite. Image 1 is original game infantry STYLE/PROPORTIONS/UNIFORM reference; image 2 is new machine-gunner reference for matching colors, pixel scale and simplification. Create ONE compact standing/moving ammunition bearer facing DOWN toward bottom of canvas. STRICT 90-degree directly overhead orthographic camera identical to image 1. Large grey-green steel helmet fully hides face and upper torso; broad rounded dark muted blue-grey shoulders, short visible legs/boots, brown leather webbing and small muted khaki backpack. Both arms down and slightly out, one hand grips a compact rectangular dark olive steel ammo tin on EACH side of his hips; two box lids with simple lighter olive lid-strip and black handle. Boxes MUST remain small, EACH box only about 0.6 helmet diameter wide; realistic infantry-sized equipment, no giant crates. A slim dark brown spare-barrel carrying case strapped diagonally across pack on upper back, subtle secondary detail. Silhouette distinguished primarily by TWO small box shapes at sides. Same chunky coarse pixel-sprite illustration, near-black thick outlines, broad simple shadows, minimal texture, muted original palette, NO bright metal. Keep exact head-to-shoulder and compact proportions of original infantry. Whole figure readable at 23 pixels high. One soldier only. No visible face, no side view, no gun in hands, no tripod, no extra loose equipment, no ground, no cast shadow, no effects, no text, no frames, no checkerboard matte. Center subject with 8 percent transparent padding. Genuine transparent alpha background.
